svg.aria-label: Case P: ensemble mean RZ and canonical chamber geometry
svg.title: Case P: ensemble mean RZ and canonical chamber geometry
svg.text: Case P: ensemble mean R-Z paths
All 287 stable source IDs, 32 seeds per participant, full 121 saved times; equal geometric aspect
Orange solid: COMSOL; blue dashed: candidate. Finite-observed per-ID seed means are illustrations, not pathwise agreement.
Green dots: common source positions. Dotted r=0: symmetry axis, not a material wall. Coordinates shown in mm.
Held/stuck observed positions remain in means; escaped missing suffixes are never reconstructed. Denominators can fall below 32.
No event-hit locations or terminal causes are inferred from ensemble means. Numeric population gates remain authoritative.
